fichas.title: Disability-friendly lift control panel
fichas.summary: A disability-friendly control panel is positioned centrally in the lift car, within reach above floor level. Buttons should be horizontal, contrasting, raised-labelled, and accompanied by acoustic signals.
uses: Allow passengers with disabilities to operate lift controls

dimensions.label: Control panel height above floor level
dimensions.context: Above floor level or car floor in the central area of the lift car
dimensions.ocr_raw: height of 85-100 em above floor level or car floor level in the central area of the lift car

dimensions.label: Button size
dimensions.context: Buttons are ideally horizontal and about 3 × 3 cm

fichas.title: Collective lift control systems
fichas.summary: Single-button collective control primarily serves car calls and considers landing calls during downward travel. Two-button collective control serves calls according to direction and is suited to buildings with frequent intermediate-floor traffic. For groups of lifts, calls and destination instructions can be considered across the group.

fichas.title: Destination floor control system
fichas.summary: Passengers enter their intended destination at a terminal and are assigned a lift. Cars normally have no selection buttons. In lift groups, this system can optimize transport capacity and integrate special lifts; identification methods can also provide access control.
uses: Assign passengers to lifts by destination

fichas.title: Double-decker lifts
fichas.summary: Two cars fixed one above the other serve different floors and increase transport capacity for the same shaft size. Access levels and sky lobbies require two levels; escalators may separate passenger flows to odd- and even-numbered floors.
uses: Serve express routes to a sky lobby

fichas.title: Multi-car lift systems
fichas.summary: Two or more independently driven cars with counterweights travel above and below one another in the same guide rails. Destination selection assigns calls and coordinates cars. The system can increase transport capacity, but cars cannot overtake, so travel between the lowest and highest stops may require changing cars; at least one conventional express lift is recommended.
uses: Coordinate multiple cars in one shaft

dimensions.label: Increase in transport capacity
dimensions.context: For the same number of shafts
dimensions.ocr_raw: This system can achieve 30% more transport capacity for the same number of shafts.
